# Brick Volley

> Brick Volley is an offline neon brick-breaker game for iPhone and Android. Drag to aim, release a volley of balls, and break the numbered bricks before the wall reaches the floor. No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Levels 1–4 are free; the full game is a one-time $0.99 purchase.

- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play), both coming soon
- Play: single player, fully offline; progress saves after every turn
- Content: 12 levels; pass through +1 rings to grow your volley
- Price: Levels 1–4 free; one in-app purchase of $0.99 unlocks Levels 5–12 and any levels added later; no subscription, no ads (store prices may vary by country)
- Privacy: collects no personal data; no analytics, ads or tracking SDKs
- Accessibility: large-text support and a reduced-motion mode

- [Privacy Policy](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/brick-volley-site/privacy.html): what the app stores (only on the device) and how purchases are handled
